name: vl-cost-optimizer
description: Cut your AI coding costs by 45% - Automatic token optimization for GitHub Copilot and AI assistants

vl.transparentMode.enabled.description: Enable transparent VL optimization for AI requests

enumDescriptions: Semantic Python minification (default): strips comments/docstrings/blank lines, output stays plain Python. Measured ~20-30% real token savings, zero correctness risk.

VL v2 (highest savings): macro compression + minification. Known multi-line patterns become one-line macro calls (~57% measured on pattern-rich code); the small macro spec is added to the prompt only when macros were detected.
Legacy VL conversion: compact VL syntax. Often costs MORE tokens than plain Python on real tokenizers (see docs/token-analysis.md).
Try all strategies and keep whichever is estimated cheapest.
